suggested_requirements.text: The system shall exchange eProcurement messages between Buyer and Seller using XML.
The system shall validate XML messages using XML schema.
The system shall include a mandatory status attribute in all documents with values: original, copy, revision, or cancellation.
The system shall include a mandatory Document UUID in all documents.
The system shall include a mandatory Document ID in all documents.
The system shall include a mandatory Document Date in all documents.
The system shall include a mandatory Document Status in all documents.
The system shall include a mandatory Test Status boolean in all documents.
The system shall include a mandatory Sender Software Manufacturer URI in all documents.
The system shall include a mandatory Sender Software Product name in all documents.
The system shall include a mandatory Sender Software Version in all documents.
The system shall include a mandatory Schema Version in all documents.
The system shall include a mandatory Party UUID for every Party instance.
The system shall include a mandatory Line UUID for every Line instance.
The system shall include a mandatory Line Number for every Line instance.
The system shall include a mandatory Line Status for every Line instance.
The system shall include a mandatory Line Quantity for every Quantified Line.
The system shall include a mandatory Amount Ex VAT for every Priced Line.
The system shall include a mandatory Item Name for every Item.
The system shall include a mandatory Unit of Measure for every Item.
The system shall include a mandatory Unit Price for every Priced Item.
The system shall include a mandatory Commodity Class for every Priced Item.
The system shall include a mandatory Extended Item ID for every Extended Item ID instance.
The system shall include a mandatory Extended Item ID Source for every Extended Item ID instance.
The system shall include a mandatory Aspect Name, Aspect Value, and Aspect Value Unit for every Aspect.
The system shall include a mandatory VAT Evidence boolean in all VAT documents.
The system shall include a mandatory Paid In Full boolean in all Invoice documents.
The system shall include a mandatory Requested Delivery Date in all RFQ documents.
The system shall include a mandatory Quoted Delivery Date in all Quotation documents.
The system shall include a mandatory Required By Date in all Purchase Order documents.
The system shall include a mandatory Rectification Action in all Rectification Advice documents.
The system shall comply with the e-Government Interoperability Framework (e-GIF).
